# Phase 1.11 — Overdue notices        (implements GENERATION_PLAN.md phase 1.11)
Milestone: `overdue_notices` returns one notice per member with overdue loans, listing each title, days late and fee (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_overdue_notices`); `notice_text` renders a notice as plain text no wider than 72 columns, with the total owed on the last line (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_notice_text`); the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`) — verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_overdue_notices` ; `python -m unittest tests.test_notice_text` ; `python -m unittest discover -s tests`

## Context
- scope: overdue notices staff can send to members; depends on nothing; builds on shelf as it stands.
- code: `shelf/reports.py` overdue_report; `shelf/loans.py` LoanDesk.overdue; `shelf/fees.py` loan_fee_cents, format_cents.

## Rationale
- one task per milestone clause, then a whole-suite task; each task adds its own test module.
- the unchecked `notice_text` clause gets a machine check: every line at most 72 columns, last line the total owed.

## Interfaces
- shelf/reports.py: overdue_notices(desk, today=None) -> [notice] one per member, loans as (title, days late, fee cents)
- shelf/reports.py: notice_text(notice) -> str, lines ≤ 72 columns, last line the total via format_cents
